additions.text: To detect shared accounts, each time a PRO account opens a lesson we store a hashed random device identifier, the browser and system type, and how many lessons it opens per day. Only the administrator sees it, it does not block access, and devices unused for 30 days are kept only for that count.
Essential · random device identifier that protects PRO accounts against sharing
